next_trial.short_unit_definition: Complete Japanese sentence/paragraph units32-64 body tokens extracted from existing train parent documents; define each complete unit as a record withEOS. Do not claim it uses the original articleEOS position.
pool_constraints: inherit parent train split; keep dev/test isolated
balanced quotations and complete sentence boundaries; reject fragments/list/code/URL/ellipsis endings
exact canonical dedup for the new small pool; exclude auxiliary dev unit text
no arbitrary token cuts or cycling the712 short documents; no full12B near-audit
record unit lengths, parent-document diversity and small content sample

evaluation.full_evaluation_policy: Web100M if screening has no major regression, to decide Base scaling; short100M only if mixture gate passes. At most2 full89416-dev/400-generation evaluations.

next_trial.interpretation: Changing both unit definition and100M dose means differences from the old25M trial do not isolate length versus dose; the equal100M control isolates mixture effect at this dose.
next_trial.stop_boundary: Finish the one paired trial and eligible full evaluations, report/commit; no automatic LR/ratio/weight sweep or5B launch.

next_trial_failure_policy: Reject the mixture without lowering its gate. Use Web100M to decide a separate general5B experiment; do not treat failed mixture adoption as proof that Base data scaling is useless.

base5B.data: Existing12.23B Web only; keep targeted short finishing in a separate optional experiment.
base5B.stop_boundary: At5B evaluate same full-dev/generation/content metrics, report/commit; decide10B from evidence, no automatic20B/50B.
